_comment: RUST-1 approved-difference registry for the Rust-vs-JavaScript differential harness.
Entry ids are harness classification ids. They are NOT the owner-decision ids D1-D9 of
RUST_0_CORE_FEASIBILITY.md section 16. RUST-0's README called its two entries 'D1' and 'D2';
those internal labels are kept in `rust0Label` only, to avoid confusion with owner decisions.
An entry approves an EXPERIMENTAL difference for this harness. It never approves a production
behaviour change; that needs its own lane and owner decision.
Adding, removing or widening an entry changes registrySha256 in every summary. Do it only
with owner review, and record it in docs/architecture/RUST_1_WASM_QA.md.

entries.inputCondition: JavaScript applied the edit set (OK), and at least one edit endpoint lies strictly between the two halves of a surrogate pair in the ORIGINAL text.
entries.justification: src/vrml/edit.js applies such a set and can emit a lone surrogate; the save path (Buffer.from(text,'utf8')) then writes U+FFFD. Rust refuses instead. Checked only after every JavaScript check has passed. Pre-existing defect T4.

ownerApproval.reference: RUST-0 accepted by owner 2026-10-08 (RUST-1 authorization). Production alignment of edit.js is TEXT-1 scope.

entries.inputCondition: The text or at least one insert is not well-formed UTF-16 (contains an unpaired surrogate).
entries.justification: UTF-8 cannot represent an unpaired surrogate; the wasm-bindgen default conversion would replace it with U+FFFD. The boundary refuses before conversion. The refusal may pre-empt a later JavaScript error (bounds/overlap) because encoding must be proven before any text reaches Rust; shape errors still match because the facade checks them first.

ownerApproval.reference: RUST-0 accepted by owner 2026-10-08 (RUST-1 authorization); RUST-1 brief section 4 (never substitute U+FFFD).

entries.inputCondition: A text-free mapping (mapOffset/mapRange) receives an offset that is not a safe integer, or its exact JavaScript result is not a safe integer.
entries.justification: src/vrml/edit.js accepts any Number.isInteger offset, so above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER its arithmetic can round silently. Rust computes exactly and refuses a value it cannot return exactly. No real document reaches this range (V8 strings are below 2^30 units).

ownerApproval.reference: New in RUST-1. Reported as a separate bucket; never counted as approved until the owner decides.
